title: Ruleset drift detector reads 1 of 3 live rulesets; main-protect and release-tags-protect change unseen
claim: Adding an `always` bypass actor to ruleset 22628467 (main-protect: deletion, non_fast_forward on main) or 23937752 (release-tags-protect: v* tags) produces 0 findings from the tree's only ruleset drift detector, while the same change to 23698884 produces 6.
mechanism: counts.mjs liveRequiredContexts collects ruleset ids only from branch rules of type required_status_checks, so the ruleset objects it fetches and policy_lint's required-contexts class compares against the recorded fixture are 23698884's alone. main-protect's force-push/deletion rules and the tag ruleset that guards releases are never read; decision 0011 records a past undocumented bypass on 22628467 that this reach could not have seen, and the plan of record noted 'fixture covers 23698884 only'.

evidence.unit: rulesets whose change the detector reports with 0 findings
evidence.contention_note: gh is a shim over the committed API snapshot (api/); no live call; a count

perturbation.change: liveRequiredContexts adds r.ruleset_id for every branch rule before the required_status_checks filter, with the temp fixture recording 22628467's ids and object (harness --perturb, temp copies of counts.mjs and the fixture)

metric_definition: Of the 3 active rulesets, the number whose bypass_actors can gain an `always` actor while requiredContextsDrift(fixture, liveRequiredContexts()) adds no finding over the unperturbed snapshot.
phenomenon_property: Every active ruleset that guards main or release tags is read and compared field by field against a recorded copy, so any change to its rules or bypass actors reddens policy-docs within one push.

null_control.value: snapshot as read: 0 findings; 23698884 + bypass: delta 6
null_control.note: the detector is alive on the ruleset it reads, so the blindness is its reach. Under --perturb 22628467's change adds 4 findings (0 on the null arm) and 23937752, on no branch's rules, stays unread: 2 -> 1.

proposed_fix_scope: Read every active ruleset (GET repos/{o}/{r}/rulesets, then each object), record all three in required-contexts.json's ruleset_objects, and compare each the way 23698884 is compared; the acceptance gains one drift arm per ruleset.
